blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَعِبَادُ الرَّحْمنِ الَّذِيْنَ يَمْشُوْنَ عَلَي اْلاَرْضِ هَوْناً۞)
blocks.tamil_translation: The servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth in humility.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَجَزَاءُ سَيِّئَةٍ سَيِّئَةٌ مِّثْلُهَا ۚ فَمَنْ عَفَا وَاَصْلَحَ فَاَجْرُهُ عَلَي اللهِ ؕ اِنَّهُ لَايُحِبُّ الظَّالِمِيْنَ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: The recompense for an evil is an evil like it; but whoever forgives and makes peace, his reward is (a responsibility) upon Allah. Indeed, He does not love the wrongdoers.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَاِذَا مَا غَضِبُوْا هُمْ يَغْفِرُوْنَ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: And when they become angry, they forgive.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي حِكَايَةً عَنْ قَوْلِ لُقْمنَ: (وَلَاتُصَعِّرْ خَدَّكَ لِلنَّاسِ وَلَا تَمْشِ فِي اْلاَرْضِ مَرَحًا ؕ اِنَّ اللهَ لَايُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخْتَالٍ فَخُوْرٍ ۞ وَاقْصِدْ فِيْ مَشْيِكَ وَاغْضُضْ مِنْ صَوْتِكَ ؕ اِنَّ اَنْكَرَ اْلاَصْوَاتِ لَصَوْتُ الْحَمِيْرِ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: And do not turn your face away from people (in pride); do not walk upon the earth arrogantly; indeed, Allah does not love anyone who is boastful and arrogant.Be moderate in your walk! Lower your voice! Indeed, the most hateful of voices is the voice of donkeys (so Luqman (AS) said to his son.
